dedupe_keys.name: centraal bureau voor de statistiek road datasets

description: Centraal_Bureau_voor_de_Statistiek: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Single Information Point Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centraal_Bureau_voor_de_Statistiek. Coverage: Centraal_Bureau_voor_de_Statistiek. The listing groups 24 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Nabijheid verblijfsobject en verkeersvoorzieningen (vanaf 01-01-2006); Verkeersindexcijfers op provinciale wegen gebaseerd op lengte van het ; Overledenen aan een verkeersongeval in Nederland (vanaf 01-01-1996); Verkeersprestaties autobussen (vanaf 01-01-2018). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-nl.
